'''Premiere - Reflections II (Modified)''' is a retro constructed format: the [[Premiere - Reflections II]] card pool with two objectives banned, ''[[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]'' and ''[[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]''. The [[Retro League]] used it for Event 5 in 2023 and 2024.<ref name="pc-gemp" /><ref name="t82167" /><ref name="t84007" />

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee [[Retro League]] (2023)
* '''Card pool:''' Premiere through Reflections II, with two objectives banned
* '''In use:''' 2023 &ndash; 2024
* '''Also called:''' P-Reflections II (w/ WYS and AOBS banned)<ref name="t82167" /><ref name="t84007" />
* '''[[GEMP]]:''' ''Premiere - Reflections II (Modified)'' (<code>premiere_ref2_m</code>) on both the Players Committee GEMP and play.swccg.com

== Card pool ==
Its card pool is that of [[Premiere - Reflections II]] (Decipher set ids 1&ndash;10 and premium ids 101&ndash;112). Two cards are banned: ''[[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]'' and ''[[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]''.<ref name="pc-gemp" /> The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

== History ==
The Retro League used the format for:
* [[2023 Retro League Event 5]], 24 September &ndash; 5 November 2023, won by [[Paul Todd Feldman]].<ref name="t82167" />
* [[2024 Retro League Event 5]], 9 October &ndash; 23 November 2024, won by [[Jonny Chu]].<ref name="t84007" />
For 2025, [[Classic (no v-cards)]] and [[Decipher Cards Only (Modified)]] replaced Premiere - Endor and Premiere - Reflections II in the league.<ref name="t85234" />
